text: You just received your tablet and it was damaged when you opened the package. You want to know the tracking number of that order first. Also if the agent can help you exchange or return the tablet (you prefer exchange for the same item, but if it is not available just return it). If tablet is returned, also cancel the charger you just bought, because it goes with the tablet. And finally, return the sneaker.
zh: 你刚刚收到了你的平板电脑，但在打开包装时它已经损坏了。你想先知道那个订单的追踪号码。另外，如果客服代表能帮你更换或退货（你更喜欢换同一个商品，但如果不可用就退货）。如果退货，也取消你刚买的充电器，因为充电器是和平板电脑一起的。最后，退货中的运动鞋。
